7.2.1.7 Creating new error domains
Any new software module with significant logical separation from all existing modules
of the Adaptive Platform should define one or more own error domains.
An error domain consists of:
•
an error condition enumeration
•
an exception base class
•
an
ara::core::ErrorDomain
subclass
•
a global
ErrorDomain
subclass accessor function
•
a global
MakeErrorCode
function overload
All these are to reside not in the
ara::core
namespace, but in the target one.
